title: Salesforce (CRM) Lands $1.6 Billion VA Deal To Power Veteran Care
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 与 VA 达成 16 亿美元交易，为退伍军人护理提供支持
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has secured a US$1.6 billion, three-year contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. The Missionforce platform will be used to modernize care and service delivery for more than 17 million veterans.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）已与美国退伍军人事务部签订了一份价值 16 亿美元、为期三年的合同。 Missionforce 平台将用于为超过 1700 万退伍军人提供现代化的护理和服务。

title: Uber’s New Acquisition and GE Aerospace’s Search for Parts
title_zh: Uber 的新收购和 GE 航空航天公司寻找零部件
summary: Uber is leaning into delivery services with its acquisition of Delivery Hero. Plus, GE Aerospace is having a hard time sourcing materials.
summary_zh: Uber 通过收购 Delivery Hero 进军配送服务领域。此外，通用电气航空航天公司在采购材料方面也遇到了困难。

title: Verizon Just Signed a More Than $1 Billion Dark Fiber Deal With Google. Here's What It Means for the 6.3% Dividend.
title_zh: Verizon 刚刚与 Google 签署了价值超过 10 亿美元的暗光纤协议。这就是 6.3% 股息的含义。
summary: The telecom giant just signed a major dark fiber agreement with one of the world's biggest AI spenders.
summary_zh: 这家电信巨头刚刚与全球最大的人工智能消费者之一签署了一项重要的暗光纤协议。

title: Oracle Stock Reverses Lower Despite Pentagon Software Deal
title_zh: 尽管有五角大楼软件交易，甲骨文股价仍下跌
summary: Oracle stock initially climbed after news of a software deal with the Pentagon. But the gains didn't hold.
summary_zh: 在与五角大楼达成软件交易的消息传出后，甲骨文股价最初上涨。但收益并没有保持。

title: ServiceNow Surges 6%, Salesforce Climbs 4% as Government AI Deals Lift Enterprise Software
title_zh: 政府人工智能交易提振企业软件，ServiceNow 飙升 6%，Salesforce 攀升 4%
summary: Federal AI contracts are pouring into enterprise software order books, and two of the sector's most beaten-down stocks are suddenly surging.
summary_zh: 联邦人工智能合同正在涌入企业软件订单簿，该行业最受打击的两只股票突然飙升。
